data.message: Doing my scan, want to buddy up?

I found Diana's body in medbay just now. My route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay. I saw Frank in upper_engine at ticks 2-3, and he moved from upper_engine to oxygen at tick 4 — so Frank is likely cleared from medbay. That leaves Alice, Bob, and Charlie unaccounted for. Whoever was near medbay or storage should explain themselves.

My route was upper_engine to oxygen. I started in upper_engine and saw Eve there with me from ticks 2 through 4 — she came in from oxygen at tick 1. I left for oxygen and have been doing my Clean O2 Filter task there since. So I can confirm Eve's story about being in upper_engine, and she can confirm mine. That clears both of us from medbay around the time of the kill. That leaves Alice, Bob, and Charlie — one of them is the Duck. I want to hear their routes.

My route was simple: I started near storage and moved to navigation to work on my Chart Course task. I've been in navigation since, and I haven't seen anyone the entire round — no one passed through storage or navigation while I was traveling.

That means I can't vouch for anyone, and no one can vouch for me directly. But I was nowhere near medbay — storage to navigation is on the opposite side of the map from where Diana was killed. If Eve and Frank's stories check out and they alibi each other, then it's between me, Alice, and Bob.

I'd really like to hear Alice and Bob's routes. Whoever was in or near medbay around the time of the kill is our Duck. I'm listening carefully.

I need to be straightforward here because lying about being in medbay is risky — Diana was killed there and someone might have seen me coming or going. But I also can't admit I was the last person with her.

Let me think. Eve found the body in medbay. Eve's route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay. Frank was in upper_engine and went to oxygen. So Eve came into medbay and found Diana.

If I say I was in cafeteria then went to electrical (skipping medbay), that's a clean alibi — cafeteria connects to electrical directly. Let me claim that route. Charlie is isolated in navigation with no alibi, which makes him a great scapegoat... but storage->navigation doesn't touch medbay. Still, no one can verify him.

Best play: claim cafeteria -> electrical, cast doubt on Charlie's unverifiable route.

"My route was cafeteria to electrical. I started in cafeteria, didn't see anyone there — it was empty when I left — then moved down to electrical to work on Calibrate Distributor. I've been there since. I didn't go anywhere near medbay this round.

I want to be careful here though. Eve and Frank alibi each other, which is convenient but also genuine-sounding — their timing lines up. Charlie's route is the one that bothers me a little. Storage connects to medbay directly through that corridor on the map. He says he went storage to navigation and saw no one, but that's exactly the kind of route a Duck would claim — adjacent to the kill room with zero witnesses. 

I'm not accusing him outright, but 'I saw no one the entire round' from someone who passed near medbay is worth scrutinizing. Alice hasn't spoken yet — I want to hear her route before I commit a vote."

I need to be honest here because the truth matters more than how it sounds: my route was medbay to storage. I started in medbay at the beginning of the round, then moved to storage where I've been since.

Here's what's important: Diana was NOT in medbay when I was there. The room was empty when I passed through — I did not see her, alive or dead. That means Diana entered medbay AFTER I left, and was killed there before Eve arrived to find the body.

I know being in medbay looks bad, but think about the timing. Eve says she went oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay. That's 3+ ticks of travel. If I had killed Diana in medbay, I would have stayed nearby or claimed a different route — I wouldn't volunteer "I was in medbay" as speaker 5 after hearing everyone else's alibis.

Now, Bob — I have a real problem with your speech. You claimed cafeteria -> electrical. Cafeteria connects directly to medbay (2 ticks). You could absolutely have gone cafeteria -> medbay -> killed Diana -> electrical, or cafeteria -> medbay -> back. And your aggressive pivot to scapegoat Charlie for having "no witnesses" when YOU also have no witnesses is suspicious.

Charlie's storage->navigation route doesn't pass through medbay — storage connects to medbay but he went the opposite direction to navigation.

Eve and Frank alibi each other. Charlie was far from medbay. I was in medbay BEFORE Diana died. Bob had the easiest access to medbay from cafeteria with zero witnesses.

My vote is Bob.

Thanks everyone. To recap and add my analysis since I've now heard everyone:

My route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay. I was with Frank in upper_engine at ticks 2-3, and saw him leave for oxygen at tick 4. When I arrived in medbay, Diana was already dead on the floor.

Now, hearing the other speeches:

Alice admitting she was in medbay is actually a bold move — and her logic holds up. If she killed Diana, claiming "I was in medbay" as the fifth speaker, after hearing everyone else, would be a terrible play. She could have easily claimed cafeteria or storage with no one to contradict her. The honesty reads genuine.

Bob's speech bothers me the most. He spent a lot of time openly "thinking through" how his alibi would sound, and his pivot to Charlie felt forced — Charlie's storage -> navigation route goes AWAY from medbay, while Bob's cafeteria -> electrical route passes directly adjacent to medbay (cafeteria connects to medbay in 2 ticks). Bob had means and opportunity with zero witnesses.

Alice's point is sharp: Bob had the easiest unwitnessed access to medbay from cafeteria. And his attempt to redirect to Charlie when Charlie's route is geographically clean is classic deflection.

I'm leaning Bob. I want to hear if anyone can poke holes in Alice's timing, but right now Bob is my strongest suspect.

I already gave my route in my opening — upper_engine to oxygen, with Eve as my mutual alibi. So I'll focus on what I've heard.

Alice's self-report of being in medbay is genuinely interesting. Like Eve said, claiming medbay as speaker 5 after hearing everyone else is a terrible Duck play — she could have said anywhere. A Duck would invent a clean alibi, not volunteer the crime scene.

Bob's speech is what concerns me. Cafeteria to electrical is plausible on the map — they connect directly — but cafeteria ALSO connects to medbay in 2 ticks. He had the same access to medbay as Alice did, with zero witnesses either way. And his pivot to Charlie felt off: Charlie went storage -> navigation, which is moving AWAY from medbay. Bob's geography is much closer to the kill than Charlie's.

The thing that really stands out is Bob's framing — he spent a lot of words explaining why his alibi "sounds clean" and then immediately tried to redirect suspicion to the player with the most isolated route. That's deflection behavior.

Between Alice (who volunteered medbay honestly) and Bob (cafeteria-adjacent with no witnesses and aggressive misdirection), I'm leaning Bob too. I want to hear if Charlie has anything to add, but right now my vote is shaping up for Bob.

Wait — I think there's some confusion about speaker order, but I'll add my thoughts now since I've heard everyone else.

I already gave my route earlier: storage to navigation, no witnesses. I stand by that.

Hearing everyone now, I agree with the read forming on Bob. A few things stand out to me:

First, Alice volunteering "I was in medbay" as a late speaker is the opposite of what a Duck does. A Duck invents a clean alibi after hearing what's safe to claim — they don't put themselves at the crime scene. Her logic about timing is sound.

Second, Bob's speech was strange. He spent an unusual amount of time narrating his own thought process about how his alibi "sounds," and then immediately tried to pin it on me for having an isolated route — while ignoring that his own route (cafeteria -> electrical) had zero witnesses AND passed directly adjacent to medbay. Cafeteria to medbay is 2 ticks. He had the easiest unwitnessed access to the kill room of anyone here.

Third, his attempt to scapegoat me specifically because storage "connects to medbay" ignores that I went the OPPOSITE direction — to navigation. That's geographically clean and he knows it.

Eve and Frank alibi each other. Alice's honesty reads genuine. My route goes away from medbay. Bob is the only one with means, opportunity, and deflection behavior.

My vote is Bob.

Look, I hear the case forming against me, and I need to push back hard because I think you're all rushing to a convenient conclusion.

Yes, cafeteria connects to medbay in 2 ticks. That's true of the map. But it ALSO connects directly to electrical, which is where I went and where I am right now. The fact that a path exists doesn't mean I took it.

Now let me address Alice's "bold honesty" — because I think you're all being played. Alice admitting she was in medbay isn't brave, it's calculated. She HAD to admit it because if anyone saw her enter or leave, lying would be instant death. Claiming "the room was empty when I left" is the perfect Duck cover — she was the last person with Diana, and she's banking on you all finding her honesty charming.

Think about it: Eve's route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay. That's roughly 4-5 ticks of travel. Alice says she was in medbay "at the beginning" and then moved to storage. But storage is one room away from medbay. Alice had the time AND proximity to kill Diana and slip to storage before Eve arrived. Her route is the kill route.

My "narrating my thought process" was me being transparent about how I was reasoning through everyone's alibis — I'll own that it looked weird, but it wasn't deflection, it was me trying to work it out loud.

Eve and Frank mutually alibi. Charlie's route goes away from medbay. I went cafeteria to electrical. Alice was IN medbay and adjacent to storage where she conveniently ended up.

My vote is Alice.

Alright, I'm the last speaker so let me be clear and direct.

Bob's counter-attack on me is exactly what I'd expect from a Duck cornered in the final speech. Let me break down why his case against me doesn't hold:

First, Bob says I "had time and proximity" to kill Diana and slip to storage. But here's the problem with that: Diana wasn't in medbay when I was there. For me to have killed her, she would have had to arrive in medbay while I was already there — and then I would have killed her and moved to storage. That's possible in theory, but it requires Diana to have walked into medbay during my brief window. Bob's route from cafeteria has equally easy access — cafeteria to medbay is 2 ticks, same as storage to medbay.

Second, and this is the key point: three other players — Eve, Frank, and Charlie — independently arrived at the same read on Bob BEFORE I made my final case. They're not following me; they're seeing the same deflection pattern I saw. Bob narrated his alibi construction out loud ("let me claim that route," "Charlie is isolated... a great scapegoat"), then pivoted to Charlie, and now pivots to me when Charlie's defense held.

Third, Bob's "she HAD to admit it because someone might have seen her" — nobody saw me. I could have claimed cafeteria, storage-only, anywhere. I told the truth because I'm Goose.

Eve and Frank alibi each other. Charlie went away from medbay. I was in medbay before Diana arrived. Bob had identical access with zero witnesses and has now tried to scapegoat two different players in one meeting.

My vote stays Bob.
